statement_summary: Annual risk assessment including supply chain threats
No SPRS score or CMMC affirmation without a documented assessment
FedRAMP Moderate or equivalent cloud for CUI; provider reviews
C-SCRM plan per SP 800-161 Rev. 1, reviewed annually
Authorized sources first; approved brokers only; no brokers for DoD jobs without approval
Manufacturer of record for every SKU; block covered manufacturers on federal orders
Supplier notice and flowdown terms in purchase orders
Unique accounts; no shared WMS zone accounts
CUI access list for the CUI share and lab
MFA for all sensitive and administrator access, including the CUI share
Same-day access removal; lab exit checklist
VPN with MFA; MSP sessions authorized, approved, and timed out
Report suspected incidents and suspect products within 1 hour
Quarantine suspect counterfeit, tampered, or covered items
Meet DIBNet 72-hour, Section 889 1-business-day, and sourcing notice clocks
Preserve images and monitoring data 90 days after a DIBNet report
Annual incident response tabletop
CUI only in the CUI share, lab workstations, and prime file share
FIPS-validated encryption for CUI
USB storage blocked; issued encrypted drives only in the lab
FCI only to vendors bound by FAR 52.204-21; DoD orders excluded from forecasting feed
Isolated immutable backups tested quarterly
Annual and quarterly training; phishing exercises; role-based and anti-counterfeit training
Call-back verification of bank-detail changes
Approved generative AI tools only; no CUI or FCI in AI tools
Escort visitors; drivers stay in the driver area
